transcript.en_text: - Viktor Petrov! - Fascist jerk-off!
transcript.zh_text: - 维克多·彼得罗夫！- 法西斯混蛋！

transcript.en_text: - Viktor Petrov! - Fascist jerk-off!
transcript.zh_text: - 维克多·彼得罗夫！- 法西斯混蛋！

transcript.en_text: This is what the freedom to assemble looks like!
transcript.zh_text: 这就是集会自由的样子！

transcript.en_text: Stop silencing the press!
transcript.zh_text: 停止压制媒体！

transcript.en_text: Stop persecuting the opposition!
transcript.zh_text: 停止迫害反对派！

transcript.en_text: Stop imprisoning people simply because they're gay!
transcript.zh_text: 停止仅仅因为他们是同性恋就监禁他们！

transcript.en_text: You're destroying Russia's future!
transcript.zh_text: 你正在摧毁俄罗斯的未来！

transcript.en_text: When Petrov's motorcade arrives, have the band already playing as loud as they can.
transcript.zh_text: 彼得罗夫的车队一到，就让乐队尽情大声演奏。

transcript.en_text: I'll speak to the colonel.
transcript.zh_text: 我会和上校谈谈。

transcript.en_text: - What about the Pussy Riot girls? - I briefed them myself.
transcript.zh_text: - Pussy Riot 乐队的女孩们呢？- 我亲自向她们做了简报。

transcript.en_text: Here's a list of the issues they want you to discuss with Petrov.
transcript.zh_text: 这是她们希望你和彼得罗夫讨论的问题清单。

transcript.en_text: - We're good to go. - Tell them I did.
transcript.zh_text: - 我们可以开始了。- 告诉他们我做到了。

transcript.en_text: Sure it's a good idea to have them at the dinner?
transcript.zh_text: 让她们出席晚宴是个好主意吗？

transcript.en_text: It's a smart idea. They're dissidents.
transcript.zh_text: 这是个好主意。她们是持不同政见者。

transcript.en_text: They've been nothing but a pain in Petrov's ass.
transcript.zh_text: 她们一直是彼得罗夫的眼中钉。

transcript.en_text: He wants to co-opt them with a photo? Fine.
transcript.zh_text: 他想用一张照片来收买她们？好吧。

transcript.en_text: If it's important to him, it's important to me.
transcript.zh_text: 如果对他很重要，那对我来说也很重要。

transcript.en_text: - Bob. - Mr. President.
transcript.zh_text: - 鲍勃。- 总统先生。

transcript.en_text: We have to get these amendments out of committee.
transcript.zh_text: 我们必须让这些修正案通过委员会。

transcript.en_text: Get AmWorks on the floor.
transcript.zh_text: 让《美利坚工程法案》提交大会讨论。

transcript.en_text: We might be able to squeeze a couple through, but not all seven.
transcript.zh_text: 我们也许能设法通过一两个，但不是全部七个。

transcript.en_text: Then restructure the funding.
transcript.zh_text: 然后重组资金。

transcript.en_text: Shoot for one amendment in one committee.
transcript.zh_text: 争取在一个委员会通过一项修正案。

transcript.en_text: Try Ways and Means.
transcript.zh_text: 试试筹款委员会。

transcript.en_text: The Republicans will never go for a lump sum.
transcript.zh_text: 共和党人绝不会同意一笔总付。

transcript.en_text: We have to split it up into jurisdictional parts.
transcript.zh_text: 我们必须将其分成具有管辖权的部分。

transcript.en_text: When I announced America Works, I promised ten million jobs.
transcript.zh_text: 当我宣布“美国就业计划”时，我承诺了千万个工作岗位。

transcript.en_text: - Maybe it's time to lower expectations. - No, look-- Pardon me, sir. President Petrov's motorcade is 15 out.
transcript.zh_text: - 也许是时候降低预期了。- 不，看—— 对不起，先生。彼得罗夫总统的车队还有15分钟就到了。

transcript.en_text: - Thank you. - I'll let you go.
transcript.zh_text: - 谢谢。- 我就不留你了。

transcript.en_text: Bob, we have a few more minutes. Please sit down.
transcript.zh_text: 鲍勃，我们还有几分钟。请坐。

transcript.en_text: You have a lot on your plate today.
transcript.zh_text: 你今天有很多事情要处理。

transcript.en_text: Why don't we pick it up tonight at the state dinner?
transcript.zh_text: 我们今晚在国宴上接着谈怎么样？

transcript.en_text: Looking forward to it, Mr. President.
transcript.zh_text: 期待着，总统先生。

transcript.en_text: What is the face of a coward?
transcript.zh_text: 懦夫的嘴脸是什么样的？

transcript.en_text: The back of his head as he runs from the battle.
transcript.zh_text: 是他逃离战场时的背影。

transcript.en_text: - Welcome, Mr. President. - Thank you, Mr. President.
transcript.zh_text: - 欢迎，总统先生。- 谢谢，总统先生。

transcript.en_text: This is your first visit to the White House?
transcript.zh_text: 这是您第一次访问白宫吗？

transcript.en_text: Yes, yes. But my third president.
transcript.zh_text: 是的，是的。但我已经见过三位总统了。

transcript.en_text: I have reviewed your proposal for the Jordan Valley.
transcript.zh_text: 我已经审阅了您关于约旦河谷的提案。

transcript.en_text: Impressive.
transcript.zh_text: 令人印象深刻。

transcript.en_text: So you liked the proposal?
transcript.zh_text: 所以你喜欢这个提议吗？

transcript.en_text: The answer is no.
transcript.zh_text: 答案是否定的。

transcript.en_text: It's not a joke, Mr. President.
transcript.zh_text: 这不是开玩笑，总统先生。

transcript.en_text: I have no interest whatsoever in pursuing your plan.
transcript.zh_text: 我根本无意推行你的计划。

transcript.en_text: Sync and corrections by n17t01 www.addic7ed.com
transcript.zh_text: n17t01 www.addic7ed.com 同步及校正

transcript.en_text: The Jordan Valley is the trees instead of the forest.
transcript.zh_text: 约旦河谷是见树不见林。

highlights.en_word: the trees instead of the forest

transcript.en_text: And this bilateral approach, it's... alienating.
transcript.zh_text: 这种双边做法…会疏远关系。

transcript.en_text: I don't often see eye to eye with Ms. Caspi, but it does feel like you're asking the state of Palestine to support a plan without having a seat at the table.
transcript.zh_text: 我与卡斯皮女士不常意见一致，但这感觉就像你们要求巴勒斯坦国支持一项计划，却不给他们谈判的席位。

transcript.en_text: Well, our goal is to soften Russia, to bring them in as a partner first-- If we can get the Russians to agree to a joint force, monitor the valley together, then they're invested.
transcript.zh_text: 我们的目标是软化俄罗斯，首先让他们作为合作伙伴加入。如果我们能让俄罗斯人同意组建联合部队，共同监视河谷，那么他们就会有所投入。

transcript.en_text: They won't be a thorn in our side when we move forward-- How can we count on the Russians?
transcript.zh_text: 当我们推进时，他们就不会成为我们的眼中钉——我们怎么能指望俄罗斯人呢？

transcript.en_text: Does your husband truly believe he can trust Petrov?
transcript.zh_text: 你丈夫真的相信他能信任彼得罗夫吗？

transcript.en_text: The president is optimistic.
transcript.zh_text: 总统很乐观。

transcript.en_text: All we ask is that you remain open-minded.
transcript.zh_text: 我们只要求你保持开放的心态。

transcript.en_text: I hope you'll convey our dissatisfaction directly to your husband.
transcript.zh_text: 我希望你能直接向你丈夫转达我们的不满。

transcript.en_text: I'll be sure to share your concerns.
transcript.zh_text: 我一定会转达你的担忧。

transcript.en_text: Ambassador Underwood will remain in contact with both of you.
transcript.zh_text: 安德伍德大使将与你们保持联系。

transcript.en_text: I shouldn't have interrupted you earlier.
transcript.zh_text: 我刚才不该打断你的。

transcript.en_text: In the meeting. It was out of place, and I should have let you do all the talking.
transcript.zh_text: 在会议上。那很不合时宜，我该让你把话说完的。

transcript.en_text: It's fine.
transcript.zh_text: 没关系。

transcript.en_text: I know you have doubts about me.
transcript.zh_text: 我知道你对我有疑虑。

transcript.en_text: The recess appointment. We haven't discussed it.
transcript.zh_text: 休会任命。我们还没讨论过。

transcript.en_text: - And we should. - It really isn't necessary.
transcript.zh_text: - 我们应该讨论。 - 真的没必要。

transcript.en_text: It is an unorthodox dynamic, yes. You will always be the First Lady.
transcript.zh_text: 这确实是一种非正统的局面。你永远是第一夫人。

transcript.en_text: This is your plane, after all. But we can work around that.
transcript.zh_text: 这毕竟是你的专机。但我们可以设法解决这个问题。

transcript.en_text: Yes, I know, but I want you to know that-- Mrs. Underwood, the president is on the line.
transcript.zh_text: 是的，我知道，但我想让你知道——安德伍德夫人，总统在线上。

transcript.en_text: - Hi. - Hey. How'd it go?
transcript.zh_text: - 嗨。 - 嘿。怎么样了？

transcript.en_text: - Should we conference Cathy in? - No, just tell me.
transcript.zh_text: - 我们要不要把凯茜也叫进来开会？ - 不，直接告诉我。

transcript.en_text: A lot of pushback. They aren't happy.
transcript.zh_text: 阻力很大。他们不高兴。

transcript.en_text: Well, they'll get on board when the time comes.
transcript.zh_text: 嗯，到时候他们会加入的。

transcript.en_text: - What about you? - He said no.
transcript.zh_text: - 你呢？ - 他拒绝了。

transcript.en_text: - First word out of his mouth. - No to everything?
transcript.zh_text: - 他说的第一句话。 - 对所有事都说不？

transcript.en_text: Oh, he might just be playing mind games, trying to throw me off balance, but this is a guy who was brought up through the KGB, after all.
transcript.zh_text: 哦，他可能只是在玩心理战术，想让我失去平衡，但这毕竟是一个在克格勃受训成长起来的人。

transcript.en_text: We're gonna have to have you and Cathy use the light touch.
transcript.zh_text: 我们得让凯茜和你采取温和的策略。

transcript.en_text: - We need to massage this. - Let's include her in this phone call.
transcript.zh_text: - 我们需要巧妙地处理这件事。 - 让她也加入这个电话会议吧。

transcript.en_text: No, just tell her. I have to go in soon.
transcript.zh_text: 不，你直接告诉她。我很快就得进去了。

transcript.en_text: It's important we don't bypass her.
transcript.zh_text: 我们不能绕过她，这很重要。

transcript.en_text: If it looks like we're leaving her out of the loop, Francis...
transcript.zh_text: 如果我们看起来像是把她排除在外，弗朗西斯...

transcript.en_text: All right, put her on.
transcript.zh_text: 好吧，让她接电话。

transcript.en_text: I can't tell you how much it would mean to the team.
transcript.zh_text: 我无法告诉你这对团队有多重要。

transcript.en_text: To have your qualifications, your expertise on board.
transcript.zh_text: 能让你的资历和专业知识加入进来。

transcript.en_text: Even just having your name on the website.
transcript.zh_text: 即使只是让你的名字出现在网站上。

transcript.en_text: I appreciate your saying that, Congressman.
transcript.zh_text: 谢谢您这么说，议员先生。

transcript.en_text: Brad. Please. Congressman's what the interns call me.
transcript.zh_text: 布拉德。拜托了。议员是实习生对我的称呼。

transcript.en_text: All right. Brad it is.
transcript.zh_text: 好的。那就叫布拉德吧。

transcript.en_text: Now as for your title, I was thinking Special Advisor?
transcript.zh_text: 至于您的头衔，我在想“特别顾问”怎么样？

transcript.en_text: - Title doesn't matter to me. - You pick what you want.
transcript.zh_text: - 头衔对我来说不重要。- 你想选什么就选什么。

transcript.en_text: And you make your own hours. Come and go as you like.
transcript.zh_text: 你可以自由安排工作时间。想来就来，想走就走。

highlights.en_word: Come and go as you like

transcript.en_text: Uh, compensation, would 220 a year work for you?
transcript.zh_text: 呃，薪酬方面，每年22万对你来说可以吗？

transcript.en_text: The cap is 173.
transcript.zh_text: 最高限额是17万3。

transcript.en_text: Well, the extra 50K would come out of my re-election fund.
transcript.zh_text: 额外的5万美元会从我的竞选连任资金中支出。

transcript.en_text: I mean, you deserve more than the cap.
transcript.zh_text: 我的意思是，你值得比最高限额更高的薪酬。

transcript.en_text: - That's a very generous offer. - Well, I expect you to earn it.
transcript.zh_text: - 这是一个非常慷慨的提议。- 嗯，我希望你物有所值。

transcript.en_text: I really want to make my mark this session.
transcript.zh_text: 我真的想在本届会议上有所作为。

transcript.en_text: - That's more than Underwood paid me. - I'm sorry?
transcript.zh_text: - 这比安德伍德付给我的还多。- 你说什么？

transcript.en_text: When I was his chief of staff, I made the cap.
transcript.zh_text: 我当他幕僚长的时候，拿的是最高限额的工资。

highlights.zh_word: 拿的是最高限额的工资

transcript.en_text: He never came anywhere near 220.
transcript.zh_text: 他给我的工资从未接近22万。

transcript.en_text: Well, like I said, I think you deserve-- It's too much money, Congressman.
transcript.zh_text: 嗯，就像我说的，我认为你值得——这钱太多了，议员先生。

transcript.en_text: Well, I disagree, but, hey, I'm not gonna argue if you want to get paid less.
transcript.zh_text: 我不同意，但是，如果你想少拿钱，我不会争辩。

transcript.en_text: As I was saying, this transpo bill, we really have an opportunity to make a difference.
transcript.zh_text: 就像我刚才说的，这项交通法案，我们真的有机会做出一番成绩。

transcript.en_text: Ladies and gentlemen, the session is over.
transcript.zh_text: 女士们先生们，会议结束了。

transcript.en_text: Please, right this way. Thank you for coming.
transcript.zh_text: 请这边走。谢谢您的到来。

transcript.en_text: I hear you've recently taken up surfing.
transcript.zh_text: 我听说您最近迷上了冲浪。

transcript.en_text: We have a few spots on the Black Sea.
transcript.zh_text: 我们在黑海有一些冲浪点。

transcript.en_text: It's mostly so I can pose for the photos.
transcript.zh_text: 我这么做主要是为了拍照摆造型。

transcript.en_text: Yes, I've seen them.
transcript.zh_text: 是的，我看到了。

transcript.en_text: It plays well with the young people.
transcript.zh_text: 这很受年轻人欢迎。

transcript.en_text: It's important they see their president has some fun, doesn't take himself too seriously.
transcript.zh_text: 重要的是，他们看到总统会找乐子，不会把自己看得太重。

transcript.en_text: I have a gift for you.
transcript.zh_text: 我为您准备了一份礼物。

transcript.en_text: I'm sorry for the delay.
transcript.zh_text: 抱歉耽搁了。

transcript.en_text: I hope we didn't keep you waiting too long.
transcript.zh_text: 希望我们没有让您久等。

transcript.en_text: Shall we?
transcript.zh_text: 我们走吧？

transcript.en_text: This was handmade by Tomas Vu, a very talented American artist.
transcript.zh_text: 这是由托马斯·吴手工制作的，他是一位非常有才华的美国艺术家。

transcript.en_text: He laser-etches images on one side, and on the other side...
transcript.zh_text: 他用激光在一面雕刻图像，而另一面则...

transcript.en_text: - he puts Beatles lyrics. - Uh-huh.
transcript.zh_text: - 他写上甲壳虫乐队的歌词。- 嗯哼。

transcript.en_text: Hm. Back in the USSR.
transcript.zh_text: 嗯。回到苏联。

transcript.en_text: It's a museum piece, but you can still ride it.
transcript.zh_text: 这是一件博物馆藏品，但您仍然可以骑它。

transcript.en_text: You should come out to my dacha in Sochi sometime.
transcript.zh_text: 您应该找个时间来索契我的乡间别墅。

transcript.en_text: We'll surf together.
transcript.zh_text: 我们会一起冲浪。

transcript.en_text: The water is cold as hell, but... the women are very warm.
transcript.zh_text: 水冷得要命，但是... 女人很热情。

transcript.en_text: Oh, I'm not sure what Claire would think about that.
transcript.zh_text: 哦，我不知道克莱尔会怎么想。

transcript.en_text: Well, bring her along.
transcript.zh_text: 嗯，把她也带上吧。

transcript.en_text: It's crawling with artists out there.
transcript.zh_text: 那里到处都是艺术家。

transcript.en_text: She might find something she likes.
transcript.zh_text: 她也许会找到她喜欢的东西。

transcript.en_text: Mr. President, I'm intrigued.
transcript.zh_text: 总统先生，我很好奇。

transcript.en_text: The first thing you say to me is "no" the second you arrive, and the next moment you're inviting me to your dacha.
transcript.zh_text: 你一到就对我说的第一件事是“不”，但下一刻你却邀请我去你的别墅。

transcript.en_text: Who am I dealing with?
transcript.zh_text: 我到底在和谁打交道？

transcript.en_text: I believe I was clear when we first met. What confuses you?
transcript.zh_text: 我想我们初次见面时我已经说得很清楚了。你有什么困惑吗？

transcript.en_text: Our delegations have been discussing these issues for months.
transcript.zh_text: 我们的代表团已经讨论这些问题好几个月了。

transcript.en_text: Yes, but discussions are not the same as commitment.
transcript.zh_text: 是的，但讨论和承诺不是一回事。

transcript.en_text: And, uh, I'm telling you now.
transcript.zh_text: 嗯，我现在告诉你。

transcript.en_text: There will be no commitment.
transcript.zh_text: 不会有任何承诺。

transcript.en_text: You could've told me that on the phone.
transcript.zh_text: 你本可以在电话里告诉我。

transcript.en_text: I assumed you were undoing an insult by having me here.
transcript.zh_text: 我以为你把我请来是为了弥补之前的侮辱。

transcript.en_text: What insult is that?
transcript.zh_text: 那是什么侮辱？

transcript.en_text: Two of your predecessors never invited me to Washington.
transcript.zh_text: 你的两位前任从未邀请我去华盛顿。

transcript.en_text: This summit is not just for show.
transcript.zh_text: 这次峰会不只是作秀。

transcript.en_text: I want to make meaningful strides toward peace.
transcript.zh_text: 我希望在和平方面取得有意义的进展。

transcript.en_text: The Middle East is hopeless. History tells us that.
transcript.zh_text: 中东局势毫无希望。历史告诉我们这一点。

transcript.en_text: I'm offering you the chance to make history.
transcript.zh_text: 我给你一个创造历史的机会。

transcript.en_text: I'll be honest with you, because you've been kind enough to invite me to your country.
transcript.zh_text: 我会对你坦诚相待，因为你很友善地邀请我来到你的国家。

transcript.en_text: Russia has nothing to gain from peace in the Middle East.
transcript.zh_text: 俄罗斯在中东和平中一无所获。

transcript.en_text: And more importantly, nothing to gain from working with America.
transcript.zh_text: 更重要的是，与美国合作也一无所获。

transcript.en_text: Israel has always distrusted us.
transcript.zh_text: 以色列一直不信任我们。

transcript.en_text: - You expect that to change? - We expect to build trust over time.
transcript.zh_text: - 你觉得这会改变吗？ - 我们希望能随着时间建立信任。

transcript.en_text: How was your meeting with the ambassadors this morning?
transcript.zh_text: 今天上午你和大使们的会面怎么样？

transcript.en_text: Ambassador Aruri called me.
transcript.zh_text: 阿鲁里大使给我打了电话。

transcript.en_text: They have their doubts, but we encouraged them to keep an open mind.
transcript.zh_text: 他们有所顾虑，但我们鼓励他们保持开放的心态。

transcript.en_text: He described it as grave concerns.
transcript.zh_text: 他将其描述为严重关切。

transcript.en_text: They will acclimate as soon as we establish-- Has your husband made direct overtures to Israel and Palestine?
transcript.zh_text: 他们很快就会适应的，只要我们建立……你丈夫是否直接向以色列和巴勒斯坦示好？

transcript.en_text: All formal communication has been handled through the State Department.
transcript.zh_text: 所有正式沟通都已通过国务院处理。

transcript.en_text: But your husband can't possibly believe they'll comply.
transcript.zh_text: 但你丈夫不可能相信他们会顺从。

transcript.en_text: Gentlemen, for the purposes of these talks, I'd appreciate it if you refer to him as the president, not as my husband.
transcript.zh_text: 各位，为了这些会谈，如果你们称他为总统而不是我丈夫，我将不胜感激。

highlights.en_word: for the purposes of these talks

transcript.en_text: Of course, Madam Ambassador.
transcript.zh_text: 当然，大使夫人。

transcript.en_text: And you really should be addressing Secretary Durant.
transcript.zh_text: 你们真应该向杜兰特部长讲话。

transcript.en_text: She speaks on his behalf more than I do.
transcript.zh_text: 她代表他发言比我多。

transcript.en_text: Our apologies, Madam Secretary. Please, continue.
transcript.zh_text: 抱歉，部长女士。请继续。

transcript.en_text: We'd like to finish reviewing the specifics, so page 12, please.
transcript.zh_text: 我们想审阅完具体细节，请翻到第12页。

transcript.en_text: Mr. President, we're already working together on several fronts: nonproliferation, the War on Terror, North Korea.
transcript.zh_text: 总统先生，我们已经在多个方面合作了：核不扩散、反恐战争、朝鲜问题。

transcript.en_text: I don't see any reason that the Middle East should be any different.
transcript.zh_text: 我认为中东地区没有任何理由与此不同。

transcript.zh_text: - 不过我表现还不错。- 你呢？

transcript.en_text: Mm-hm.
transcript.zh_text: 嗯哼。

transcript.en_text: - I think we should play. - What?
transcript.zh_text: - 我觉得我们应该玩一局。- 什么？

transcript.en_text: Oh, you can't be serious.
transcript.zh_text: 哦，你不是认真的吧。

transcript.en_text: Excuse me? Can you ask housekeeping to bring us some ping-pong balls, please?
transcript.zh_text: 不好意思？你能让客房服务给我们拿些乒乓球过来吗？

transcript.en_text: I have got to go home.
transcript.zh_text: 我得回家了。

transcript.en_text: We'll be playing by Harvard rules.
transcript.zh_text: 我们会按哈佛的规则玩。

transcript.en_text: You have to admire their fearlessness.
transcript.zh_text: 你不得不佩服他们的无所畏惧。

transcript.en_text: None of them understand, do they?
transcript.zh_text: 他们没人理解，不是吗？

transcript.en_text: What it takes to govern.
transcript.zh_text: 治理国家需要付出什么。

transcript.en_text: They scream and yell and stomp their feet, but if they had to spend just one day in our shoes, the weight we carry on our shoulders...
transcript.zh_text: 他们尖叫、大喊、跺脚，但如果他们只需要有一天站在我们的位置上，我们肩上的重担...

highlights.en_word: the weight we carry on our shoulders

transcript.en_text: Like, um... the Middle East?
transcript.zh_text: 就像，嗯……中东？

transcript.en_text: Oh, I know why we're here, smoking our cigars.
transcript.zh_text: 哦，我知道我们为什么在这里抽雪茄了。

transcript.en_text: - And? - You're not going to like it.
transcript.zh_text: - 然后呢？- 你不会喜欢它的。

transcript.en_text: Yes! Ha-ha!
transcript.zh_text: 是！哈哈！

transcript.en_text: Drink up.
transcript.zh_text: 喝完。

transcript.en_text: Okay. For the Crimson.
transcript.zh_text: 好的。为了深红队。

transcript.en_text: Damn!
transcript.zh_text: 该死！

transcript.en_text: Yes! I still got it.
transcript.zh_text: 是！我宝刀未老。

transcript.en_text: You don't have to drink that.
transcript.zh_text: 你不必喝那个。

transcript.en_text: I accept your mercy.
transcript.zh_text: 我接受你的仁慈。

transcript.en_text: And I am going to leave before you challenge me to a rematch.
transcript.zh_text: 我要在你挑战我进行复赛之前离开了。

transcript.en_text: You're not even gonna give me a shot at winning in my own house?
transcript.zh_text: 你甚至不打算在我自己的地盘上给我一个赢的机会吗？

transcript.en_text: First rule of diplomacy: stop while you're ahead, which is what I should've done, after that third vodka of Petrov's.
transcript.zh_text: 外交的第一条准则：见好就收，这正是我在喝了彼得罗夫的第三杯伏特加之后应该做的。

transcript.en_text: What do you think of him?
transcript.zh_text: 你觉得他怎么样？

transcript.en_text: Petrov? I don't know.
transcript.zh_text: 彼得罗夫？我不知道。

transcript.en_text: You were the one who talked to him all night.
transcript.zh_text: 你才是和他聊了一整晚的人。

transcript.en_text: Well, I didn't have much of a choice.
transcript.zh_text: 好吧，我没得太多选择。

transcript.en_text: So, not a fan?
transcript.zh_text: 所以，不是他的粉丝？

transcript.en_text: I think he's very intelligent. And he has a charm.
transcript.zh_text: 我觉得他很聪明。他很有魅力。

transcript.en_text: That kiss was... too much.
transcript.zh_text: 那个吻……有点过分了。

transcript.en_text: No, that's just pushing buttons.
transcript.zh_text: 不，那只是在惹恼别人。

transcript.en_text: The Russians love to do that.
transcript.zh_text: 俄罗斯人就喜欢那样做。

transcript.en_text: Good night.
transcript.zh_text: 晚安。

transcript.en_text: I don't think he's to be trusted, Cathy.
transcript.zh_text: 我觉得他不可信，凯茜。

transcript.en_text: Especially after tonight. And it made me think...
transcript.zh_text: 尤其是在今晚之后。这让我开始思考...

transcript.en_text: Go on.
transcript.zh_text: 说下去。

transcript.en_text: It made me wonder about Francis' plan.
transcript.zh_text: 这让我开始怀疑弗朗西斯的计划。

transcript.en_text: I'm not sure that it's a good idea to be partnered with Petrov.
transcript.zh_text: 我不确定和彼得罗夫合作是不是个好主意。

transcript.en_text: In the meantime, we alienate Israel and Palestine.
transcript.zh_text: 与此同时，我们疏远了以色列和巴勒斯坦。

transcript.en_text: Well... between you and me, I agree.
transcript.zh_text: 嗯……说句悄悄话，我同意。

transcript.en_text: Sit with me.
transcript.zh_text: 坐下陪我。

transcript.en_text: What would you do differently?
transcript.zh_text: 你会怎么做不同？

transcript.en_text: Well...
If the goal is to get troops into the Jordan Valley, well, then there's more than one way to skin that cat.
transcript.zh_text: 如果目标是将部队部署到约旦河谷，那么，方法可不止一种。

highlights.en_word: more than one way to skin that cat

transcript.en_text: A multinational force?
transcript.zh_text: 一支多国部队？

transcript.en_text: I would go through the UN.
transcript.zh_text: 我会通过联合国。

transcript.en_text: Peacekeeping?
transcript.zh_text: 维和行动？

transcript.en_text: You wouldn't get past Russia's veto.
transcript.zh_text: 你过不了俄罗斯的否决关。

transcript.en_text: There might be a way, but...
transcript.zh_text: 也许有办法，但是...

transcript.en_text: you'd have a lot of responsibility on your shoulders.
transcript.zh_text: 你肩上的责任会很重。

transcript.en_text: Well, if you can give me guidance, I'm sure I can handle it.
transcript.zh_text: 嗯，如果你能给我指导，我相信我能处理好。

transcript.en_text: There is precedent with the Uniting for Peace Resolution.
transcript.zh_text: 联合国“为和平而团结”决议有先例可循。

transcript.en_text: We used it to get around the Russians for the Korean War.
transcript.zh_text: 我们曾用它来绕开俄罗斯对朝鲜战争的阻挠。

transcript.en_text: - The whole thing? - From Poland to the UK.
transcript.zh_text: - 整个系统？ - 从波兰到英国的那个。

transcript.en_text: I want the entire missile defense system gone.
transcript.zh_text: 我要让整个导弹防御系统消失。

transcript.en_text: You know that's there to defend against North Korea, against Iran.
transcript.zh_text: 你知道那是用来防御朝鲜和伊朗的。

transcript.en_text: And far closer to my borders than theirs.
transcript.zh_text: 而且离我的边界比离他们的近得多。

transcript.en_text: I'm asking for a few thousand troops in the Jordan Valley.
transcript.zh_text: 我要求在约旦河谷部署几千名士兵。

transcript.en_text: You're asking me to dismantle Europe's defense system.
transcript.zh_text: 你却要求我拆除欧洲的防御系统。

transcript.en_text: What you're really asking for is American forces just south of the Caucasus.
transcript.zh_text: 你真正要求的是在高加索以南部署美军。

transcript.en_text: You must have a strategic play in mind.
transcript.zh_text: 你一定有战略考量。

transcript.en_text: This is about stability in the region.
transcript.zh_text: 这是为了该地区的稳定。

transcript.en_text: You're trying to consolidate your foothold in the region. Hm?
transcript.zh_text: 你是在试图巩固你在该地区的立足点，嗯？

transcript.en_text: The Black Sea, Kazakhstan, Chechnya, Crimea.
transcript.zh_text: 黑海、哈萨克斯坦、车臣、克里米亚。

transcript.en_text: So, please... don't insult me with peace.
transcript.zh_text: 所以，拜托……别拿和平来侮辱我。

transcript.en_text: Whatever your strategic goals may be, the missile defense system is mine.
transcript.zh_text: 无论你的战略目标是什么，导弹防御系统都是我的。

transcript.en_text: Viktor, I invited you to Washington with pure intentions, so that we could break bread and learn to trust one another.
transcript.zh_text: 维克多，我邀请你来华盛顿是出于纯粹的善意，希望我们能共进晚餐，学着彼此信任。

transcript.en_text: Francis, I don't get softened up by a nice dinner and dancing with a beautiful woman.
transcript.zh_text: 弗朗西斯，我不会因为一顿美餐和与美女跳舞就被软化了。

transcript.en_text: You asked me what I want.
transcript.zh_text: 你问我想要什么。

transcript.en_text: Well... I told you.
transcript.zh_text: 嗯……我告诉过你了。

transcript.en_text: I'll tell you what.
transcript.zh_text: 我告诉你吧。

transcript.en_text: It's my turn to get some sleep.
transcript.zh_text: 轮到我睡觉了。

transcript.en_text: Let's attack all this with a fresh mind.
transcript.zh_text: 让我们带着清醒的头脑来处理这一切。

transcript.en_text: We've barely smoked our cigars.
transcript.zh_text: 我们几乎还没怎么抽雪茄呢。

transcript.en_text: We're not men of excess, though, are we?
transcript.zh_text: 不过，我们也不是挥霍无度的人，不是吗？

transcript.en_text: Aren't we?
transcript.zh_text: 是吗？

transcript.en_text: No, no.
transcript.zh_text: 不，不。

transcript.en_text: No, you're right.
transcript.zh_text: 不，你说得对。

transcript.en_text: Enough smoke for one evening.
transcript.zh_text: 今晚抽够了。

transcript.en_text: What are you going to do?
transcript.zh_text: 你打算怎么办？

transcript.en_text: I don't know.
transcript.zh_text: 我不知道。

transcript.en_text: Try to meet him halfway.
transcript.zh_text: 试着跟他各退一步，达成和解。

transcript.en_text: Cathy and I were talking.
transcript.zh_text: 凯茜和我在谈话。

transcript.en_text: Maybe the Israelis and the Palestinians are right.
transcript.zh_text: 也许以色列人和巴勒斯坦人是对的。

transcript.en_text: We should consider starting with them.
transcript.zh_text: 我们应该考虑从他们开始入手。

transcript.en_text: Use the United Nations to put pressure on Russia.
transcript.zh_text: 利用联合国向俄罗斯施压。

transcript.en_text: - How? - Uniting for Peace.
transcript.zh_text: - 怎么做？ - 团结谋和平。

transcript.en_text: General Assembly overrides a Russian veto in the Security Council.
transcript.zh_text: 联合国大会否决了安理会中俄罗斯的否决权。

transcript.en_text: Well, that'll just antagonize them even if it works. And it won't.
transcript.zh_text: 那只会激怒他们，就算奏效也一样。何况它根本不会奏效。

transcript.en_text: Well, it might work. Cathy seems to think it could.
transcript.zh_text: 嗯，它也许会奏效。凯茜似乎觉得有可能。

transcript.en_text: I thought you believed in this plan.
transcript.zh_text: 我还以为你相信这个计划呢。

transcript.en_text: We were just... brainstorming alternatives.
transcript.zh_text: 我们只是在...集思广益，寻找替代方案。

transcript.en_text: Well, I've worked too hard on it just to abandon it.
transcript.zh_text: 我为此付出了太多努力，不能就这样放弃。

transcript.en_text: Okay, you know best.
transcript.zh_text: 好的，你最清楚。

transcript.en_text: Do you mind?
transcript.zh_text: 你介意吗？

transcript.en_text: What?
transcript.zh_text: 什么？

transcript.en_text: The light.
transcript.zh_text: 灯光。

transcript.en_text: Francis.
transcript.zh_text: 弗朗西斯。

transcript.en_text: He's a thug.
transcript.zh_text: 他是个恶棍。

transcript.en_text: Smart, but he's still a thug.
transcript.zh_text: 聪明，但他仍然是个恶棍。

transcript.en_text: Don't cower to him.
transcript.zh_text: 别向他屈服。

transcript.en_text: Where I come from, we drop a raw egg into some tomato juice and drink that.
transcript.zh_text: 在我老家，我们把生鸡蛋打进番茄汁里喝。

transcript.en_text: Luckily, I don't come from there.
transcript.zh_text: 幸好，我不是那里人。

transcript.en_text: That's a perfect job for Doug. I can't imagine why he'd turn it down.
transcript.zh_text: 那对道格来说是份完美的工作。我无法想象他为什么会拒绝。

transcript.en_text: He thinks we were behind it.
transcript.zh_text: 他认为我们在背后操纵。

transcript.en_text: I told him we weren't, but I don't think he believes me.
transcript.zh_text: 我告诉他我们没有，但我不认为他相信我。

transcript.en_text: Said he doesn't need training wheels.
transcript.zh_text: 他说他不需要辅助轮。

transcript.en_text: Well, I want you to still stop in from time to time and see him.
transcript.zh_text: 嗯，我还是希望你时不时地去看看他。

transcript.en_text: Yes, sir.
transcript.zh_text: 是的，先生。

transcript.en_text: Is the Secretary of Defense here? Send him in.
transcript.zh_text: 国防部长来了吗？让他进来。

transcript.en_text: - Mr. President. - We don't have much time.
transcript.zh_text: - 总统先生。- 我们时间不多了。

transcript.en_text: Petrov gets here in 90 minutes. We need to talk Europe.
transcript.zh_text: 彼得罗夫90分钟后到。我们需要谈谈欧洲。

transcript.en_text: The answer is yes.
transcript.zh_text: 答案是肯定的。

transcript.en_text: - To some, not all, of what you asked. - I see.
transcript.zh_text: - 对于你所问的一些问题，并非全部。- 我明白了。

transcript.en_text: I'm prepared to scale back significantly.
transcript.zh_text: 我准备好大幅度缩减。

transcript.en_text: Now, I have to speak to my team first and my allies in NATO, but I'm confident that we can do something meaningful in Poland and the Czech Republic.
transcript.zh_text: 现在，我必须先和我的团队以及北约的盟友谈谈，但我相信我们可以在波兰和捷克共和国做一些有意义的事情。

transcript.en_text: Now, our people can work out the specifics.
transcript.zh_text: 现在，我们的人可以商定具体细节。

transcript.en_text: And whatever it is we decide and agree on, the public cannot know.
transcript.zh_text: 无论我们决定和同意什么，公众都不能知道。

transcript.en_text: I woke up with the taste of those cigars in my mouth.
transcript.zh_text: 我醒来时嘴里还留着那些雪茄的味道。

transcript.en_text: Thinking of Cuba and Kennedy.
transcript.zh_text: 想着古巴和肯尼迪。

transcript.en_text: I won't be humiliated the way Khrushchev was with Turkey.
transcript.zh_text: 我不会像赫鲁晓夫与土耳其那样蒙受屈辱。

transcript.en_text: Well, you can't possibly compare what I'm proposing to what happened then.
transcript.zh_text: 嗯，你不能把我提议的与当时发生的事情相提并论。

transcript.en_text: I can only consider a partial scale-back if you announce it.
transcript.zh_text: 如果你宣布，我只能考虑部分缩减。

transcript.en_text: This press conference is about the Jordan Valley.
transcript.zh_text: 这次新闻发布会是关于约旦河谷的。

transcript.en_text: The most important thing about the missiles is the scale-back, not the PR.
transcript.zh_text: 关于导弹最重要的是缩减，而不是公关。

transcript.en_text: My people would know I walked away with something.
transcript.zh_text: 我的人民会知道我有所收获。

transcript.en_text: And, by announcing it, I can keep you to your word.
transcript.zh_text: 而且，通过宣布，我能让你信守诺言。

transcript.en_text: I am more than meeting you halfway, Viktor.
transcript.zh_text: 维克托，我这不仅仅是折中让步。

transcript.en_text: You know what the best part of the fall of the Soviet Union was?
transcript.zh_text: 你知道苏联解体最棒的部分是什么吗？

transcript.en_text: The cars.
transcript.zh_text: 那些汽车。

transcript.en_text: Have you ever been in, um... a Lada?
transcript.zh_text: 你坐过，嗯……拉达车吗？

transcript.en_text: Lada? No, I haven't.
transcript.zh_text: 拉达车？不，我没有。

transcript.en_text: No? Oh. It's the worst car ever built.
transcript.zh_text: 没有吗？哦。那是建造过的最差的汽车。

transcript.en_text: Tiny, little thing, you know.
transcript.zh_text: 小小的，你知道的。

transcript.en_text: Your head would hit the ceiling when you hit a pothole.
transcript.zh_text: 你遇到坑洼时，头会撞到天花板。

transcript.en_text: And the heat never worked.
transcript.zh_text: 而且暖气从来没好过。

transcript.en_text: And no air conditioning.
transcript.zh_text: 也没有空调。

transcript.en_text: You know, your skin would stick to the seats in the summer.
transcript.zh_text: 你知道的，夏天你的皮肤会粘在座位上。

transcript.en_text: It was a coffin on wheels.
transcript.zh_text: 它简直就是个带轮子的棺材。

transcript.en_text: But then, after the fall, we got the Lexus.
transcript.zh_text: 但后来，秋天过后，我们买了雷克萨斯。

transcript.en_text: Temperature control. Automatic windows.
transcript.zh_text: 温度控制。自动车窗。

transcript.en_text: And so much room.
transcript.zh_text: 空间还很大。

transcript.en_text: First time I fucked my ex-wife, in a Lexus.
transcript.zh_text: 我第一次和我的前妻在雷克萨斯里那个。

transcript.en_text: You could never do that in a Lada.
transcript.zh_text: 在拉达车里你可做不到。

transcript.en_text: No space. Huh?
transcript.zh_text: 没空间。是吧？

transcript.en_text: You see, Mr. President.
transcript.zh_text: 总统先生，您看。

transcript.en_text: I want the Lexus.
transcript.zh_text: 我想要雷克萨斯。

transcript.en_text: And you're trying to sell me a Lada.
transcript.zh_text: 而你却想卖给我一辆拉达。

transcript.en_text: I'll have them bring your motorcade around.
transcript.zh_text: 我会让人把您的车队开过来。

transcript.en_text: But the... press conference.
transcript.zh_text: 但是……新闻发布会。

transcript.en_text: Oh. Right!
transcript.zh_text: 哦。对！

transcript.en_text: I'd completely forgotten.
transcript.zh_text: 我完全忘了。

transcript.en_text: But I think we're gonna be okay without one today.
transcript.zh_text: 但我想我们今天没有也没关系。

transcript.en_text: Have a safe journey home, Mr. President.
transcript.zh_text: 总统先生，祝您一路平安。

transcript.en_text: Thank you for your hospitality, Mr. President.
transcript.zh_text: 总统先生，感谢您的款待。

transcript.en_text: Give me the Secretary of State.
transcript.zh_text: 让我接国务卿。

transcript.en_text: The president will be speaking alone. No joint conference.
transcript.zh_text: 总统将单独讲话。没有联合会议。

transcript.en_text: The president will be out shortly.
transcript.zh_text: 总统很快就会出来。

transcript.en_text: Last night, I had the pleasure of hosting some very special guests here at the White House.
transcript.zh_text: 昨晚，我很荣幸在白宫接待了一些非常特别的客人。

transcript.en_text: True Russian patriots who exhibit the very best that their country has to offer.
transcript.zh_text: 真正的俄罗斯爱国者，他们展现了他们国家所能提供的最优秀品质。

highlights.en_word: exhibit the very best that their country has to offer
highlights.zh_word: 展现了他们国家所能提供的最优秀品质

transcript.en_text: Their names: Nadya Tolokonnikova, Masha Alyokhina and Pyotr Verzilov.
transcript.zh_text: 他们的名字是：纳迪亚·托洛科尼科娃、玛莎·阿廖希娜和彼得·维尔齐洛夫。

transcript.en_text: As you're all aware, they stood up to President Petrov, and forced him to listen to the truths that he didn't want to hear.
transcript.zh_text: 你们都知道，他们挺身对抗彼得罗夫总统，迫使他倾听他不想听的真相。

transcript.en_text: And, well, that had a profound effect on me.
transcript.zh_text: 嗯，那对我产生了深远的影响。

transcript.en_text: Because it made me realize that I need to stand up to him as well.
transcript.zh_text: 因为这让我意识到我也需要对抗他。

transcript.en_text: As does our country.
transcript.zh_text: 我们的国家也一样。

transcript.en_text: When I invited the president here, I set out hoping to find a partner.
transcript.zh_text: 当我邀请总统来这里时，我出发时是希望能找到一个伙伴的。

transcript.en_text: But the demands that President Petrov made proves to me that peace is not a priority for him.
transcript.zh_text: 但彼得罗夫总统提出的要求向我证明，和平对他来说不是优先事项。

transcript.en_text: Peace should not have to be bought.
transcript.zh_text: 和平不应该被买卖。

transcript.en_text: Peace should be its own reward, and we will achieve it, with or without him.
transcript.zh_text: 和平本身就应该是回报，无论有没有他，我们都会实现它。

transcript.en_text: Thank you very much.
transcript.zh_text: 非常感谢。

transcript.en_text: You have thoughts on how to bypass Russia.
transcript.zh_text: 你对如何绕过俄罗斯有什么想法。

transcript.en_text: The idea is to negate Russia's veto in the Security Council.
transcript.zh_text: 这个想法是为了否定俄罗斯在安理会的一票否决权。

transcript.en_text: I'll let the ambassador tell you what we have in mind.
transcript.zh_text: 我会让大使告诉你我们有什么计划。
